title_hi: भू-स्थानिक विश्लेषक – वन & Land-Use मानचित्रण — ATREE
role_summary: This position supported ATREE's geospatial lab on applied research covering forest cover change, land-use transitions, and urban green infrastructure across Karnataka and the Western Ghats. The analyst processed satellite imagery and drone datasets, maintained spatial databases, and prepared cartographic outputs for peer-reviewed publications and state-level advisory reports.
summary_hi: यह कॉर्पोरेट / गैर-सरकारी संगठन में पूर्णकालिक पद ATREE (Karnataka) हेतु उपलब्ध है। आवश्यक योग्यता: Bachelor's / Master's degree in the relevant discipline or equivalent experience। आवेदन एवं पात्रता की पूर्ण जानकारी हेतु आधिकारिक पोर्टल अवश्य देखें।
key_responsibilities: Process and classify multispectral satellite imagery for forest cover and land-use change analysis
Build and maintain spatial databases and metadata standards for long-term research datasets
Prepare maps, figures, and spatial statistics for research publications and policy briefs
Support field teams with GPS data collection protocols and coordinate validation exercises
Contribute to urban heat island and green infrastructure assessments in Bengaluru
application_tip: Portfolios carry the most weight for this role. Link a GitHub page or PDF portfolio demonstrating classification workflows, accuracy assessments, and cartographic design quality rather than listing software alone.
qualification_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree in the relevant discipline or equivalent experience

title_hi: रिसर्च एसोसिएट – जलवायु नीति & शासन — WRI India
role_summary: This role supported WRI India's climate program on state-level climate action planning and governance research. The associate conducted policy analysis, synthesised evidence from state action plans and national missions, and contributed to stakeholder consultations with state governments and research partners across southern India.
summary_hi: यह प्रोजेक्ट एसोसिएट / रिसर्च एसोसिएट WRI India (Karnataka) हेतु उपलब्ध है। आवश्यक योग्यता: M.Sc. / M.Tech. / B.Tech. in the relevant discipline, as per the project advertisement। आवेदन एवं पात्रता की पूर्ण जानकारी हेतु आधिकारिक पोर्टल अवश्य देखें।
key_responsibilities: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research on state climate governance frameworks and institutional mandates
Draft policy notes, working papers, and presentation decks for internal and external stakeholders
Support stakeholder consultations, workshops, and capacity-building sessions with state departments
Track climate finance, adaptation, and mitigation developments across Indian states
Coordinate with partner organisations on joint research outputs and timelines
application_tip: Tailor your writing sample to climate governance in an Indian federal context. Reviewers look for crisp policy writing and evidence of quantitative rigor; attach one analytical piece you authored end-to-end.
qualification_summary: M.Sc. / M.Tech. / B.Tech. in the relevant discipline, as per the project advertisement

clean_title: Programme Officer – Urban Forestry & Green Cover
title_hi: कार्यक्रम अधिकारी – शहरी वानिकी & हरित Cover — WWF-India
role_summary: The Programme Officer coordinated urban forestry and green cover initiatives linked to national urban greening missions. Responsibilities spanned species planning, plantation monitoring, nursery partnerships, and community engagement with municipal bodies and resident welfare associations in the National Capital Region.
summary_hi: यह कॉर्पोरेट / गैर-सरकारी संगठन में पूर्णकालिक पद WWF-India (Delhi NCR) हेतु उपलब्ध है। आवश्यक योग्यता: Bachelor's / Master's degree in the relevant discipline or equivalent experience। आवेदन एवं पात्रता की पूर्ण जानकारी हेतु आधिकारिक पोर्टल अवश्य देखें।
key_responsibilities: Design and supervise urban plantation programs aligned with native species and biodiversity principles
Coordinate with municipal corporations, nurseries, and community groups on plantation drives
Monitor survival rates and prepare green cover progress reports for programme leadership
Develop outreach material and conduct awareness sessions with schools and resident associations
Support proposal development for urban forestry and restoration funding
application_tip: Quantify your field experience: hectares planted, survival percentages, or number of communities coordinated. Familiarity with CAMPA or municipal green budgets is a strong differentiator for this portfolio.
qualification_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree in the relevant discipline or equivalent experience

title_hi: सलाहकार – ESG Disclosures & BRSR Reporting — CEEW
role_summary: This consulting assignment supported CEEW's sustainable finance workstream on corporate ESG disclosure practice in India, including BRSR adoption and assurance readiness. The consultant analysed disclosure quality across listed companies and prepared guidance material for industry and regulator-facing audiences.
summary_hi: यह यंग प्रोफेशनल / परामर्शदाता (संविदा) CEEW (Delhi NCR) हेतु उपलब्ध है। आवश्यक योग्यता: Master's degree in the relevant discipline with 0-3 years of experience, as per the scheme norms। आवेदन एवं पात्रता की पूर्ण जानकारी हेतु आधिकारिक पोर्टल अवश्य देखें।
key_responsibilities: Assess BRSR filings for completeness, comparability, and alignment with evolving SEBI requirements
Develop analytical notes and benchmarking studies on corporate ESG disclosure quality
Engage with industry representatives on assurance readiness and data governance practices
Support capacity-building workshops for companies new to regulated ESG reporting
Contribute to policy inputs on sustainable finance frameworks
application_tip: Go beyond naming frameworks: cite specific BRSR principle-wise disclosures you have prepared or reviewed, and any exposure to assurance processes under ISAE 3000 or equivalent standards.
qualification_summary: Master's degree in the relevant discipline with 0-3 years of experience, as per the scheme norms

clean_title: Research Fellowship – Environmental Policy & Climate Governance
title_hi: अनुसंधान फेलोशिप – पर्यावरणीय नीति & जलवायु शासन — TERI
role_summary: This fellowship placed early-career researchers within TERI's policy research vertical, working on environmental governance, climate negotiations support, and sustainable development analyses. Fellows contributed to research reports, policy briefs, and multi-institution research projects under senior mentorship.
summary_hi: यह फेलोशिप / इंटर्नशिप TERI (Delhi NCR) हेतु उपलब्ध है। आवश्यक योग्यता: Recent graduate / postgraduate in the relevant discipline, as per the fellowship norms। आवेदन एवं पात्रता की पूर्ण जानकारी हेतु आधिकारिक पोर्टल अवश्य देखें।
key_responsibilities: Conduct literature reviews and policy analysis on environmental governance and climate topics
Contribute to research reports, policy briefs, and conference papers
Support data collection, cleaning, and analysis for interdisciplinary research projects
Assist in organising consultations, workshops, and research dissemination events
Track national and international environmental policy developments
application_tip: Fellowship selection favours a focused research statement over an exhaustive CV. State one environmental governance question you want to pursue and how your academic background prepares you to investigate it.
qualification_summary: Recent graduate / postgraduate in the relevant discipline, as per the fellowship norms

title_hi: प्रबंधक – कार्बन Credit Origination — EKI Energy Services
role_summary: This position led carbon credit origination across community and industrial projects in central India, spanning feasibility assessment, baseline studies, and registry documentation. The manager coordinated validation and verification processes and engaged project partners on benefit-sharing structures for voluntary and compliance market programs.
summary_hi: यह कॉर्पोरेट / गैर-सरकारी संगठन में पूर्णकालिक पद EKI Energy Services (Madhya Pradesh) हेतु उपलब्ध है। आवश्यक योग्यता: Bachelor's / Master's degree in the relevant discipline or equivalent experience। आवेदन एवं पात्रता की पूर्ण जानकारी हेतु आधिकारिक पोर्टल अवश्य देखें।
key_responsibilities: Identify and screen carbon offset project opportunities across forestry, cookstoves, and industrial efficiency
Oversee baseline studies, project design documents, and registry submissions
Coordinate validation, monitoring, and verification cycles with accredited agencies
Negotiate benefit-sharing and monitoring agreements with project partners and communities
Track carbon market pricing, methodology updates, and Article 6 developments
application_tip: Show a full lifecycle you have personally owned: which methodology, which registry, and your role through validation. Specificity about project types (cookstoves, agroforestry, waste-to-energy) beats general carbon market familiarity.
qualification_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree in the relevant discipline or equivalent experience
